text:
maria (partnerships): Quick check-in: EdgeForge asked to bundle OpenArbor-7B into their SI appliance (downloadable quant) AND list a managed SKU in their marketplace. Need policy + runbook.
jamal (bd): they want both. downloads for named SI customers, hosted for general marketplace.
sara-legal: Stop-gap: check upstream license + redistribution addendum. Likely require provenance metadata, no rebranding, and export screening.
hugo-eng: Tech: we must produce reproducible 4-bit artifacts, include conversion script, and add a tiny shim for their runtime. Suggest simple CI that verifies logits on smoke inputs.
anya-ops: Ops: downloads must be signed + manifest + partner entitlement gating. We can geo-block while legal does export review.
liz-marketing: Co-launch request: EdgeForge wants simultaneous PR + listing. Marketing needs 3 weeks lead and approved logos/copy.
sara-legal: Proposed commercial paths: (1) Hosted: Redwood hosts, revenue share; (2) SI Certified DL: signed quant weights to named customers under an addendum (12mo redistribution cap, attribution, patch cadence).
maria (partnerships): Action items: sara: draft addendum + export check (Thu), hugo: quant CI + conversion docs (next Tue), anya: entitlement + signed artifact plan (Wed), liz: draft launch timeline (3d), jamal: term sheet to partner (Fri).
jamal (bd): partner asked for privacy-first telemetry (opt-in). ok?
sara-legal: Opt-in only, no raw prompts, aggregated metrics. Draft DPA clause.
hugo-eng: will emit hashed prompt-shape + latency buckets, opt-in flag in runtime.
maria (partnerships): Great — will update EdgeForge. Reconvene after jamal sync. :rocket:
